meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用你自己的 cmem.ai 凭据(同步令牌、用户 id、SyncHub URL)写入 claude-mem-cowork 插件的 config.json,让 hook 能捕获和注入记忆。令牌只通过文件读写传递,不会回显在对话里。
howto.when: 当你说「set up claude-mem」「connect cmem」等关键词,或直接粘贴 cmem.ai Connect 的三个凭据值时,它会接管配置。

say.text: 帮我用 cmem.ai 的凭据配置 claude-mem
检查一下 cmem 配对是否成功
say.note: 运行 status,只报掩码结果

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin with your own cmem.ai credentials (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) so hooks can capture and inject memory. The token is moved only via file reads/writes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "set up claude-mem", "connect cmem", or similar, or paste the three cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL).

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem with my cmem.ai credentials
Here is my sync token and user id, pair my cloud sync
